title: HTH v0.1 event envelope
description: Fields shared by every Human Task Handoff event. Receivers MUST ignore properties they do not know.

id.description: Event id; stable across retransmissions of the same event. Receivers deduplicate on it.

key.description: Opaque task key assigned by the registrar.

project.description: Project whose state document holds the task.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the event was created.

text.description: Task text as declared (label and key marker removed).

due.description: Calendar date by which the task should be done.

context.description: Free-form tag for why the task was registered (e.g. a bulk import).

inferred.description: True only on a registrar's inferred done.

evidence.description: Why the registrar believes the task is done.
